title: Erdős Problem 128

steps.statement:
∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (M : SimpleGraph V),
    0 < Fintype.card V → M.CliqueFree 3 →
    (∀ I : Set V, M.IsIndepSet I → 5 * I.ncard < 2 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∀ v : V, Fintype.card V < 3 * (M.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∀ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V →
      50 * (M.induce V').edgeSet.ncard > Fintype.card V ^ 2) →
    (∃ (i : ℕ) (dy de : Bool) (ψ : V → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8),
      2 ≤ i ∧
      let act : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Prop := fun v => match v with
        | .inl k => ¬ (de = true ∧ k.val = 2 * i - 1)
        | .inr j => ¬ (dy = true ∧ j.val = 1)
      let adj : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Prop := fun a b => match a, b with
        | .inl p, .inl q => let N := 3 * i - 1; let d := (q.val + N - p.val) % N; i ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2 * i - 1
        | .inl p, .inr q | .inr q, .inl p =>
            (p.val < i ∧ (q.val = 2 ∨ q.val = 5)) ∨
            (i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i ∧ (q.val = 3 ∨ q.val = 6)) ∨
            (2 * i ≤ p.val ∧ (q.val = 4 ∨ q.val = 7))
        | .inr p, .inr q =>
            (p.val = 0 ∧ (q.val = 1 ∨ q.val = 2 ∨ q.val = 3 ∨ q.val = 4)) ∨
            (q.val = 0 ∧ (p.val = 1 ∨ p.val = 2 ∨ p.val = 3 ∨ p.val = 4)) ∨
            (p.val = 1 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 6 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨
            (q.val = 1 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 6 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 2 ∧ (q.val = 6 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨ (q.val = 2 ∧ (p.val = 6 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 3 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨ (q.val = 3 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 4 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 6)) ∨ (q.val = 4 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 6))
      (∀ v, act (ψ v)) ∧ (∀ w, act w → ∃ v, ψ v = w) ∧ ∀ u v, M.Adj u v ↔ adj (ψ u) (ψ v)) → False

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (M : SimpleGraph V),
    M.CliqueFree 3 →
    (∀ u v : V, u ≠ v → ¬ M.Adj u v → ∃ w : V, M.Adj u w ∧ M.Adj v w) →
    (∀ v : V, Fintype.card V < 3 * (M.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    ¬ M.Colorable 3 →
    (∃ (i : ℕ) (dy de : Bool) (ψ : V → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8),
      2 ≤ i ∧
      let act : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Prop := fun v => match v with
        | .inl k => ¬ (de = true ∧ k.val = 2 * i - 1)
        | .inr j => ¬ (dy = true ∧ j.val = 1)
      let adj : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → Prop := fun a b => match a, b with
        | .inl p, .inl q => let N := 3 * i - 1; let d := (q.val + N - p.val) % N; i ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2 * i - 1
        | .inl p, .inr q | .inr q, .inl p =>
            (p.val < i ∧ (q.val = 2 ∨ q.val = 5)) ∨
            (i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i ∧ (q.val = 3 ∨ q.val = 6)) ∨
            (2 * i ≤ p.val ∧ (q.val = 4 ∨ q.val = 7))
        | .inr p, .inr q =>
            (p.val = 0 ∧ (q.val = 1 ∨ q.val = 2 ∨ q.val = 3 ∨ q.val = 4)) ∨
            (q.val = 0 ∧ (p.val = 1 ∨ p.val = 2 ∨ p.val = 3 ∨ p.val = 4)) ∨
            (p.val = 1 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 6 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨
            (q.val = 1 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 6 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 2 ∧ (q.val = 6 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨ (q.val = 2 ∧ (p.val = 6 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 3 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 7)) ∨ (q.val = 3 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 7)) ∨
            (p.val = 4 ∧ (q.val = 5 ∨ q.val = 6)) ∨ (q.val = 4 ∧ (p.val = 5 ∨ p.val = 6))
      (∀ v, act (ψ v)) ∧ (∀ w, act w → ∃ v, ψ v = w) ∧ ∀ u v, M.Adj u v ↔ adj (ψ u) (ψ v))

∀ w : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 8 → ℝ,
    (∀ z, 0 ≤ w z) →
    (∑ z, w z) = 1 →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 0) + w (Sum.inr 1) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 3) + w (Sum.inr 4) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 1) + w (Sum.inr 6) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 4) + w (Sum.inr 7) →
    w (Sum.inr 0) + w (Sum.inr 2) + w (Sum.inr 4) + w (Sum.inr 7) < 2 / 5 →
    w (Sum.inr 1) + w (Sum.inr 3) + w (Sum.inr 5) + w (Sum.inr 6) < 2 / 5 →
    ∃ s : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 8 → ℝ,
      (∀ z, 0 ≤ s z ∧ s z ≤ w z) ∧
      (∑ z, s z) = 1 / 2 ∧
      25 * (∑ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 8, ∑ y : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 8,
        match x, y with
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inl q =>
            if 2 ≤ (q.val + 5 - p.val) % 5 ∧ (q.val + 5 - p.val) % 5 ≤ 3 then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inr t =>
            if ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < 2) ∨
               ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ 2 ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 4) ∨
               ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 4 ≤ p.val) then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inr t, Sum.inl p =>
            if ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < 2) ∨
               ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ 2 ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 4) ∨
               ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 4 ≤ p.val) then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inr t₁, Sum.inr t₂ =>
            if (t₁.val < 6 ∧ t₂.val < 6 ∧ ((t₁.val + 1) % 6 = t₂.val ∨ (t₂.val + 1) % 6 = t₁.val)) ∨
               (t₁.val = 6 ∧ (t₂.val = 0 ∨ t₂.val = 4 ∨ t₂.val = 2 ∨ t₂.val = 7)) ∨
               (t₂.val = 6 ∧ (t₁.val = 0 ∨ t₁.val = 4 ∨ t₁.val = 2 ∨ t₁.val = 7)) ∨
               (t₁.val = 7 ∧ (t₂.val = 3 ∨ t₂.val = 1 ∨ t₂.val = 5 ∨ t₂.val = 6)) ∨
               (t₂.val = 7 ∧ (t₁.val = 3 ∨ t₁.val = 1 ∨ t₁.val = 5 ∨ t₁.val = 6)) then s x * s y else 0) ≤ 1

∀ (i : ℕ), 3 ≤ i → ∀ w : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → ℝ,
    (∀ z, 0 ≤ w z) →
    (∑ z, w z) = 1 →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 0) + w (Sum.inr 1) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 3) + w (Sum.inr 4) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 1) + w (Sum.inr 6) →
    0 < w (Sum.inr 4) + w (Sum.inr 7) →
    w (Sum.inr 0) + w (Sum.inr 2) + w (Sum.inr 4) + w (Sum.inr 7) < 2 / 5 →
    w (Sum.inr 1) + w (Sum.inr 3) + w (Sum.inr 5) + w (Sum.inr 6) < 2 / 5 →
    ∃ s : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8 → ℝ,
      (∀ z, 0 ≤ s z ∧ s z ≤ w z) ∧
      (∑ z, s z) = 1 / 2 ∧
      25 * (∑ x : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8, ∑ y : Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8,
        match x, y with
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inl q =>
            if i ≤ (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ∧
               (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ≤ 2 * i - 1 then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inr t =>
            if ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
               ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
               ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val) then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inr t, Sum.inl p =>
            if ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
               ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
               ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val) then s x * s y else 0
        | Sum.inr t₁, Sum.inr t₂ =>
            if (t₁.val < 6 ∧ t₂.val < 6 ∧ ((t₁.val + 1) % 6 = t₂.val ∨ (t₂.val + 1) % 6 = t₁.val)) ∨
               (t₁.val = 6 ∧ (t₂.val = 0 ∨ t₂.val = 4 ∨ t₂.val = 2 ∨ t₂.val = 7)) ∨
               (t₂.val = 6 ∧ (t₁.val = 0 ∨ t₁.val = 4 ∨ t₁.val = 2 ∨ t₁.val = 7)) ∨
               (t₁.val = 7 ∧ (t₂.val = 3 ∨ t₂.val = 1 ∨ t₂.val = 5 ∨ t₂.val = 6)) ∨
               (t₂.val = 7 ∧ (t₁.val = 3 ∨ t₁.val = 1 ∨ t₁.val = 5 ∨ t₁.val = 6)) then s x * s y else 0) ≤ 1

/- ### Part 1: Fractional-to-Integral Sparse-Half Rounding Lemma -/

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    12 ≤ Fintype.card V →
    G.CliqueFree 3 →
    (∀ u v : V, u ≠ v → ¬ G.Adj u v → ∃ w : V, G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj v w) →
    (∀ v : V, Fintype.card V < 3 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∃ v : V, 29 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 10 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∃ (v u : Fin 5 → V) (w : V),
      ∀ i : Fin 5,
        G.Adj (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∧ G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 1)) ∧
        G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 4)) ∧ G.Adj w (u i)) →
    ∃ (i : ℕ), 2 ≤ i ∧ ∃ φ : V → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8,
      ∀ x y : V, G.Adj x y →
        match φ x, φ y with
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inl q =>
            i ≤ (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ∧
            (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ≤ 2 * i - 1
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inr t =>
            ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
            ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
            ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val)
        | Sum.inr t, Sum.inl p =>
            ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
            ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
            ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val)
        | Sum.inr t₁, Sum.inr t₂ =>
            (t₁.val < 6 ∧ t₂.val < 6 ∧ ((t₁.val + 1) % 6 = t₂.val ∨ (t₂.val + 1) % 6 = t₁.val)) ∨
            (t₁.val = 6 ∧ (t₂.val = 0 ∨ t₂.val = 4 ∨ t₂.val = 2 ∨ t₂.val = 7)) ∨
            (t₂.val = 6 ∧ (t₁.val = 0 ∨ t₁.val = 4 ∨ t₁.val = 2 ∨ t₁.val = 7)) ∨
            (t₁.val = 7 ∧ (t₂.val = 3 ∨ t₂.val = 1 ∨ t₂.val = 5 ∨ t₂.val = 6)) ∨
            (t₂.val = 7 ∧ (t₁.val = 3 ∨ t₁.val = 1 ∨ t₁.val = 5 ∨ t₁.val = 6))

-- H2: Vega graph sparse-half elimination:
-- Every finite graph admitting a homomorphism to a Vega graph Υ_i^{00} (i ≥ 2) has a sparse half.

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : ℕ), 2 ≤ i →
    (∃ φ : V → Fin (3 * i - 1) ⊕ Fin 8,
      ∀ x y : V, G.Adj x y →
        match φ x, φ y with
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inl q =>
            i ≤ (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ∧
            (q.val + (3 * i - 1) - p.val) % (3 * i - 1) ≤ 2 * i - 1
        | Sum.inl p, Sum.inr t =>
            ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
            ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
            ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val)
        | Sum.inr t, Sum.inl p =>
            ((t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 3) ∧ p.val < i) ∨
            ((t.val = 4 ∨ t.val = 1) ∧ i ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 2 * i) ∨
            ((t.val = 2 ∨ t.val = 5) ∧ 2 * i ≤ p.val)
        | Sum.inr t₁, Sum.inr t₂ =>
            (t₁.val < 6 ∧ t₂.val < 6 ∧ ((t₁.val + 1) % 6 = t₂.val ∨ (t₂.val + 1) % 6 = t₁.val)) ∨
            (t₁.val = 6 ∧ (t₂.val = 0 ∨ t₂.val = 4 ∨ t₂.val = 2 ∨ t₂.val = 7)) ∨
            (t₂.val = 6 ∧ (t₁.val = 0 ∨ t₁.val = 4 ∨ t₁.val = 2 ∨ t₁.val = 7)) ∨
            (t₁.val = 7 ∧ (t₂.val = 3 ∨ t₂.val = 1 ∨ t₂.val = 5 ∨ t₂.val = 6)) ∨
            (t₂.val = 7 ∧ (t₁.val = 3 ∨ t₁.val = 1 ∨ t₁.val = 5 ∨ t₁.val = 6))) →
    ∃ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V ∧
      50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2

/- ### Part 1: Basic triangle-free and Property D_m helpers -/

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), G.CliqueFree 3 →
    3 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 < 20 * G.edgeSet.ncard →
    5 * G.edgeSet.ncard < Fintype.card V ^ 2 →
    (∃ v, 8 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∃ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I ∧ 2 * Fintype.card V ≤ 5 * I.ncard) →
    (∀ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I → 12 * I.ncard < 5 * Fintype.card V) →
      ∃ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V ∧
        50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2

-- Known (Norin and Yepremyan 2015): upper middle range with 5n/14 ≤ δ(G) ≤ 3n/8 and α(G) < 2n/5.

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), G.CliqueFree 3 →
    3 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 < 20 * G.edgeSet.ncard →
    5 * G.edgeSet.ncard < Fintype.card V ^ 2 →
    (∃ v, 8 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∀ v, 5 * Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∀ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I → 5 * I.ncard < 2 * Fintype.card V) →
      ∃ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V ∧
        50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2

-- Open core of the upper middle range: δ(G) < 5n/14 and α(G) < 2n/5.

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), G.CliqueFree 3 →
    3 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 < 20 * G.edgeSet.ncard →
    5 * G.edgeSet.ncard < Fintype.card V ^ 2 →
    (∃ v, 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard < 5 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∀ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I → 5 * I.ncard < 2 * Fintype.card V) →
      ∃ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V ∧
        50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2

/-! ## Common helpers -/

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    G.CliqueFree 3 →
    ¬ G.Colorable 3 →
    (∀ v : V, Fintype.card V < 3 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∃ v : V, 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard < 5 * Fintype.card V) →
    ∃ (v u : Fin 5 → V) (w : V),
      ∀ i : Fin 5,
        G.Adj (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∧
        G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 1)) ∧
        G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 4)) ∧
        G.Adj w (u i)

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    12 ≤ Fintype.card V →
    73 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 < 800 * G.edgeSet.ncard →
    500000 * G.edgeSet.ncard < 99999 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 →
    (∀ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I → 5 * I.ncard < 2 * Fintype.card V) →
    ¬ G.Colorable 3 →
    (∀ v : V, Fintype.card V < 3 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∃ v : V, 29 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 10 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∃ (v u : Fin 5 → V) (w : V),
      ∀ i : Fin 5,
        G.Adj (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∧
        G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 1)) ∧
        G.Adj (u i) (v (i + 4)) ∧
        G.Adj w (u i)) →
    (∃ (M : Set V) (tag : V → Fin 3) (idx : V → Fin 5),
      2 * Fintype.card V < 3 * M.ncard ∧
      ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ y ∈ M, G.Adj x y →
        (tag x = 0 ∧ tag y = 0 ∧ (idx y = idx x + 1 ∨ idx y = idx x + 4)) ∨
        (tag x = 0 ∧ tag y = 1 ∧ (idx y = idx x + 1 ∨ idx y = idx x + 4)) ∨
        (tag x = 1 ∧ tag y = 0 ∧ (idx y = idx x + 1 ∨ idx y = idx x + 4)) ∨
        (tag x = 1 ∧ tag y = 2) ∨
        (tag x = 2 ∧ tag y = 1)) →
    (∀ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V →
      50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard > Fintype.card V ^ 2) →
    ¬ G.CliqueFree 3

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    G.CliqueFree 3 →
    (∀ u v : V, u ≠ v → ¬ G.Adj u v → ∃ w : V, G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj v w) →
    (∀ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V →
      50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard > Fintype.card V ^ 2) →
    (∀ v : V, 5 * Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    ¬ G.Colorable 3 →
    (¬ ∃ (o m : Fin 5 → V) (z : V), ∀ i : Fin 5, G.Adj (o i) (o (i + 1)) ∧ G.Adj (m i) (o (i + 1)) ∧
      G.Adj (m i) (o (i + 4)) ∧ G.Adj z (m i)) →
    (∃ v : Fin 8 → V, ∀ i j : Fin 8, (j = i + 1 ∨ j = i + 4 ∨ j = i + 7) →
      ¬ (i = 2 ∧ j = 6) → ¬ (i = 6 ∧ j = 2) → G.Adj (v i) (v j)) →
    (¬ ∃ φ : Fin 11 → V, ∀ i j : Fin 11, (j = i + 1 ∨ j = i + 4 ∨ j = i + 7 ∨ j = i + 10) →
      G.Adj (φ i) (φ j)) →
    False

-- Band, homomorphic image of And(4) present.

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    G.CliqueFree 3 →
    (∀ u v : V, u ≠ v → ¬ G.Adj u v → ∃ w : V, G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj v w) →
    (∀ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V →
      50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard > Fintype.card V ^ 2) →
    (∀ v : V, 5 * Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    ¬ G.Colorable 3 →
    (¬ ∃ (o m : Fin 5 → V) (z : V), ∀ i : Fin 5, G.Adj (o i) (o (i + 1)) ∧ G.Adj (m i) (o (i + 1)) ∧
      G.Adj (m i) (o (i + 4)) ∧ G.Adj z (m i)) →
    (∃ φ : Fin 11 → V, ∀ i j : Fin 11, (j = i + 1 ∨ j = i + 4 ∨ j = i + 7 ∨ j = i + 10) →
      G.Adj (φ i) (φ j)) →
    False

/-- Band Step 3 (adapted from `colorable_three_of_no_v8_minus_e` of reduction R2, iskamag, PR #1798):
    maximal triangle-free + `5α < 2n` + `35δ > 12n` + no `V_8 - (2, 6)` implies 3-colourable. -/

∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
    12 ≤ Fintype.card V →
    73 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 < 800 * G.edgeSet.ncard →
    500000 * G.edgeSet.ncard < 99999 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 →
    (∀ I : Set V, G.IsIndepSet I → 5 * I.ncard < 2 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∃ a b c d : V, a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a) →
    (∃ a b c d e : V, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ a ≠ e ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ b ≠ e ∧
      c ≠ d ∧ c ≠ e ∧ d ≠ e ∧ G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d e ∧ G.Adj e a) →
    (∃ a b c d : V, a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj c d ∧
      ¬ G.Adj a c ∧ ¬ G.Adj a d ∧ ¬ G.Adj b c ∧ ¬ G.Adj b d) →
    ¬ G.Colorable 3 →
    (∀ v : V, 5 * Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard) →
    (∃ v : V, 11 * (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 4 * Fintype.card V) →
    (∀ V' : Set V, 2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V →
      50 * (G.induce V').edgeSet.ncard > Fintype.card V ^ 2) →
    ¬ G.CliqueFree 3
